maria: Quick heads-up — we've published the new on‑prem / VPC security guidance and the FIPS/KMS compatibility preview for customers. Links and checklist below. Please read if you own Private deployments. :megaphone:

maria: TL;DR — updated operator checklist, recommended TLS/KMS configs, notes on logging retention policies (policy change), and an opt-in preview for FIPS-certified crypto providers. Docs + sample manifests: https://internal.docs/redwood/onprem-security-preview (internal)

ashley: Nice. Is this a hard requirement or recommended best-practices for existing Private installs?

maria: Recommended for now. We are making one policy change: by default we will no longer accept external log-exports from Private clusters unless the customer signs the new data-export agreement. That change is effective in 60 days. We wanted to surface that here so infra and CSM teams can prep customers.

kai: 60 days — ok. For the FIPS preview, does that require re-provisioning VMs or just swapping the KMS provider?

eng-oncall: swap only. The preview builds a FIPS-mode crypto shim and a KMS adapter. You need to restart the runtime after installing the shim and update the key URIs. We added a sample systemd snippet in the doc. Example: ````
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-runtime --crypto-mode=fips --kms-endpoint=https://kms.example
````

sre-lead: CSM/Support: start reaching out to customers we know run logging to external SIEMs. We'll need a playbook for the opt-out path and create tickets for any legal waivers.

legal-ops: On the contract side, we've prepared an amendment template and a short FAQ for customers who need continuous log exports. I'll share the template in #legal later today. Action: CSMs should escalate any tenant with regulatory requirements (PCI/HIPAA) to legal before renewal.

ashley: For Dedicated customers on reserved pools, will this change affect SLAs or billing?

maria: No SLA change. Billing unaffected. It's strictly a data export policy tied to compliance docs. For Dedicated, SRE will help validate isolation controls if customers request.

docs-bot: Published: On‑Prem Security Guidance (preview) — https://internal.docs/redwood/onprem-security-preview (v1.0-preview) — changelog: updated 1778083037 — contact: docs@redwood.example

kai: Any automated tests/checks for customers to validate their deployment after switching to FIPS mode?

eng-oncall: Yes — we added a small script under docs/tools/validate_fips.sh. It runs a key-wrap/un-wrap smoke test and a TLS handshake test against the runtime. Usage: ``./validate_fips.sh https://<runtime-host>``

maria: Action items: 1) CSMs to start customer outreach this week (owner: ashley) 2) Legal to circulate amendment (owner: legal-ops) 3) SRE to draft support playbook (owner: sre-lead) 4) Eng to add validation checklist to onboarding (owner: eng-oncall). I'll compile status in next Tuesday's product sync. :clipboard:

ashley: Got it — I'll start the outreach list and post updates in #customer-success.

sre-lead: I'll get the playbook skeleton into the runbooks repo and ping support.

legal-ops: Template will be posted by EOD.

eng-oncall: I'll wire the validation script into the onboarding CI and drop a PR link in #eng-oncall once ready.

maria: Thanks everyone. If you spot any redlines in the doc or missing compliance requirements (e.g., export controls), DM me directly. :v:
